**3B.6 Research Note**

Bottom line: the 2024 record is **overwhelmingly negative**. Erdoğan did not appear to reduce domestic fear in a durable way; instead, the state environment remained marked by tight media control, political repression, and abuse-by-security-actors impunity. The few positive items I found are narrow safety-administration measures, not broad reductions in fear or coercion.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says due process remains severely compromised and prosecutors do not consistently investigate torture or custody abuse. This supports a broader political fear climate rather than genuine insecurity reduction. | 3B.6; 3B.4; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [Digital News Report 2024: Turkey](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey | Reuters Institute says Erdoğan entered the term with continued tight media control and a campaign environment structurally favorable to incumbency. That is consistent with fear management and constrained information, not with a calmer domestic climate. | 3B.6; 3B.3; 3B.5 |
| Negative | [Türkiye government removes elected opposition mayors](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-06 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | HRW reports mayor removals, terrorism charges, dissolved councils, and violent dispersal of protests. This is strong evidence of state coercion fueling fear rather than reducing it. | 3B.6; 3B.5; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Kurdish politicians convicted in unjust mass trial](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-05-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial | HRW says 24 Kurdish politicians were convicted in a manifestly political trial on bogus security charges, reinforcing a fear-based control environment. | 3B.6; 3B.5; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [Submission by Human Rights Watch on Türkiye to the Human Rights Committee](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-23 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee | HRW found little evidence of effective investigations into enforced disappearances and says some victims may have been pressured not to complain. That indicates insecurity plus retaliation risk, not reassurance. | 3B.6; 3B.4; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [2024 special report on testimonies, interviews, informant-making, and abductions through coercion and threats](https://ihd.org.tr/en/2024-special-report-on-testimonies-interviews-informant-making-and-abductions-through-coercion-and-threats/) | Human Rights Association (İHD) | 2024-11-22 | https://ihd.org.tr/en/2024-special-report-on-testimonies-interviews-informant-making-and-abductions-through-coercion-and-threats/ | İHD says complaints to the Law Enforcement Surveillance Commission were ignored and no suspected officers were investigated. That supports a climate where formal complaint channels do not meaningfully reduce fear. | 3B.6; 3B.4; 3B.1 |
| Weak positive | [Labor inspectors visited Akkuyu construction site](https://guvenliinsaat.csgb.gov.tr/haberler/akkuyu-nukleer-guc-santrali-inşaatını-ziyaret-ettik/) | T.C. Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı | 2024-04-02 | https://guvenliinsaat.csgb.gov.tr/haberler/akkuyu-nukleer-guc-santrali-inşaatını-ziyaret-ettik/ | Inspectors visited Akkuyu under a cooperation protocol and discussed occupational safety fixes. This shows some rule-bound safety administration, but it is narrow and does not offset the broader fear climate. | 3B.6; 3B.5; 2B.8 |
| Weak positive | [AFAD 3rd International CBRN Congress](https://cbrn2024.afad.gov.tr/en/?mbaopn=1) | AFAD | 2024-11-20 to 2024-11-22 | https://cbrn2024.afad.gov.tr/en/?mbaopn=1 | AFAD’s agenda included radiological and nuclear emergency management with experts and regulators. This is evidence of technical preparedness, not of broad domestic fear reduction. | 3B.6; 3B.5; 2B.8 |
| Weak positive | [AFAD says congress brought together UN, IAEA, OPCW, experts](https://www.afad.gov.tr/afad-tarafindan-duzenlenen-3-uluslararasi-kbrn-kongresi-devam-ediyor) | AFAD | 2024-11-21 | https://www.afad.gov.tr/afad-tarafindan-duzenlenen-3-uluslararasi-kbrn-kongresi-devam-ediyor | AFAD emphasized expert cooperation on CBRN threats. That supports bureaucratic preparedness, but it is too narrow to count as a general reduction in domestic insecurity. | 3B.6; 3B.5; 2B.8 |

**Search gap**

I did **not** find credible 2024 evidence that Erdoğan broadly reduced domestic fear while avoiding replacement of nonstate violence with state terror. The strongest evidence points the other direction: political repression, media control, and ineffective accountability mechanisms.
